_source: AHG program structure, not handbook prose — committable. The outlines (goal, objectives, verse wording) are transcribed from the Pathfinder Unit Leader Guide into data/pathfinder/stones.json (gitignored) — see handbook/pathfinder.example.json for its shape.
_fannyCrosbyDerived: Fanny Crosby requirements the tracker proposes from beads: 1 = one activity from each stepping stone (all six stone beads), 2 = at least one service project (a service star bead).
